parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- true: sends a check request without creating an endpoint. The system checks whether the AccessKey pair is valid, whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user has the authorization, and whether required parameters are specified.
- false (default): triggers the request to create an endpoint.
